name: Novo Selo

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Chardonnay, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Sandstone is sand bound into rock. It weathers to light, sandy soil that drains freely. Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water. Marl is a limy clay. It holds water and makes vines ripen later, which keeps acidity in the grapes.
soil.top: The topsoil stores water through dry spells, but stays wet and cold after rain, which slows ripening and can swell the grapes. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
